outcome: Minimal — most munitions intercepted before reaching Israeli airspace

sources.idf_statement: IDF reported 170 drones, 30 cruise missiles, 120 ballistic missiles launched; 99% interception rate

description: First wave of Shahed-136 loitering munitions and Paveh cruise missiles intended to saturate Israeli air defenses (Iron Dome, David's Sling) ahead of the ballistic missile wave. Drones launched several hours before ballistic missiles due to slower flight speed (~185 km/h for Shahed-136 vs minutes for ballistic missiles).

outcome: Minor damage to Nevatim Airbase (base remained operational); debris fell in Arad region

sources.idf_statement: 99% of incoming weapons intercepted; minor damage to Nevatim Airbase

description: Second wave of 120 ballistic missiles (Emad, Ghadr, Kheibar Shekan, possibly Shahab-3B) timed to arrive after drone wave had engaged Israeli air defense systems. Ballistic missiles launched later but arrived within minutes due to much higher velocity. Several missiles struck Nevatim Airbase area causing minor damage.

outcome: Nevatim Airbase: hangar and taxiway damaged (20-32 impacts confirmed by satellite); Tel Nof Airbase: several impacts; Gedera: school building hit

sources.idf_statement: IDF reported approximately 200 ballistic missiles fired in two waves

description: First wave of approximately 100 ballistic missiles targeting Israeli military airbases and intelligence facilities. Unlike TP1, no drones or cruise missiles were used — Iran opted for a purely ballistic approach to minimize warning time. Missiles included Emad, Ghadr-H, Ghadr-F, and Kheibar Shekan. Iran gave only a few hours' warning to Arab states (compared to 72 hours in TP1).

outcome: Missiles landed near Mossad/Unit 8200 HQ (~500m); homes and restaurant damaged in north Tel Aviv area; additional impacts at Nevatim and Tel Nof
description: Second wave included Iran's Fattah-1 hypersonic missile in its first confirmed combat use, alongside additional Emad and Kheibar Shekan missiles. This wave targeted the Mossad/Unit 8200 headquarters complex at Glilot near Tel Aviv in addition to the airbases. Satellite imagery later showed missiles landing approximately 500m from the Mossad complex.

outcome: Serious damage to sensitive military centers in Tel Aviv area
State of emergency declared across Israel

outcome: Continued escalation — strikes on urban areas
Haifa oil refinery directly hit and shut down
Bat Yam residential building struck — 9 killed (incl. 5 Ukrainian nationals), 200+ injured, 61 buildings damaged. Worst single incident of the war.
Targeted command and control systems

outcome: Nevatim Airbase absorbed ~32 MRBMs; direct hit on hardened F-35I shelter (IDF claimed no aircraft damaged). Glilot intel base hit. Tel Nof base hit. Kirya HQ damaged.
Fattah-1 used to destroy air defense radar systems

14 strategic military sites targeted including Hadera power plant, Haifa oil refinery, Ovda airbase (cyber command), Kiryat Gat semiconductor zone, Rafael center Haifa. Bazan Oil Refinery struck (3 killed, refinery shut down). Haifa Power Plant struck (fire).
Ben Gurion Airport temporarily shut down; flight diversions for 36 hours

Impacts reported in Tel Aviv (1 fatality, 21 injuries) and Bnei Brak (several injuries). Damage to US facilities in Gulf region.

sources.idf_statement: IDF reports high interception rate in coordination with allies; minor damage to one base

description: First wave of Operation True Promise 4; large-scale coordinated attack with drones to saturate defenses followed by ballistic missiles. Launched hours after US-Israeli Operation Epic Fury/Roaring Lion strikes on Iran.
Second wave continuing initial retaliatory barrage on Feb 28; 2-4 missiles per salvo pattern observed.

outcome: Abdullah Al-Mubarak Air Base in Kuwait reportedly disabled. Damage to Harir base in Iraq.
description: Third wave; IRGC announced using more advanced missiles than True Promise 3. Expanded targeting to Gulf logistics infrastructure.

outcome: Continued strikes on Gulf and Israeli targets
description: Fourth wave; continued expansion of targeting to military-industrial sites in Israel and Gulf bases.

outcome: IRGC claims strikes on American vessels and Abdullah Mubarak naval base in Kuwait. Oil tanker reportedly struck in Indian Ocean.
description: Fifth wave; shift to maritime and Gulf targets. IRGC Navy involvement. MSP and MST logistics vessels in Indian Ocean reportedly struck (unverified).

outcome: IRGC claims hits on Tel Nof Air Base, HaKirya HQ, and Haifa naval installations
description: Sixth wave; escalation to targeting Israeli political-military command infrastructure in dense urban Tel Aviv. IRGC signaling ability to strike leadership centers.

outcome: Three US/British oil tankers in Persian Gulf struck and reportedly engulfed in fire. Ali Al-Salem naval base Kuwait shut down. Heavy damage to US base in Bahrain.
description: Seventh wave; massive expansion to maritime targets. IRGC claims 4 ballistic missiles fired at USS Abraham Lincoln carrier. Three oil tankers struck. Major Gulf base attacks.

outcome: IRGC claims 560 US military killed/wounded across waves 7-8 (unverified). Continued tanker fires.
description: Eighth wave; continuation of wave 7 operations. IRGC claims massive US casualties (560 killed/wounded - unverified). Large-scale drone deployments.

outcome: IRGC claims strikes on 60 strategic targets and 500 combined US/Israeli sites since operation start. Cluster munition warhead strike near Tel Aviv injured 12.
description: Ninth wave; IRGC claims 700+ drones and hundreds of missiles launched since operation began. Cluster munition warhead used against Tel Aviv area (12 injuries).

outcome: IRGC claims hits on Israeli government complex in Tel Aviv, military/security centers in Haifa, and East Jerusalem. Strike in Beersheba injured at least 10.

sources.idf_statement: IDF assessing damage from advanced missile strikes

description: Tenth wave; featured advanced Kheibar Shekan maneuvering missiles (MaRV-equipped, Mach 8, 500-1500kg warhead). IRGC stated it 'opened the great gates of fire upon the occupied territories.'

outcome: IRGC claims strikes on US intelligence centers, military support warehouses in Persian Gulf, Israeli army communications complex in Beersheba, 20+ points in Tel Aviv/West Jerusalem/Galilee
description: Eleventh wave; naval and aerospace IRGC units. Targeted communications and intelligence infrastructure. IRGC claims 500 sites targeted in preceding 48 hours.

outcome: IRGC Navy claims: Arifjan base Kuwait hit by 12 drones in two phases; Al Minhad base UAE hit by 6 drones and 5 ballistic missiles; US naval facilities Bahrain destroyed by 6 drones; fuel tanker Athens Nova in Strait of Hormuz struck by 2 drones and still burning.
description: Twelfth wave; IRGC Navy-led maritime campaign. 26 drones and 5 ballistic missiles targeting US assets in three Gulf countries plus Strait of Hormuz maritime target.

outcome: IRGC claims strikes on US Marine Corps installations at Arifjan base Kuwait
description: Thirteenth wave; IRGC Navy drone unit targeting Kuwaiti-based US Marine installations. Marked first clear indication of different IRGC branches coordinating successive waves under unified command.

outcome: IRGC claims main command building and HQ of US air base destroyed; fuel tanks set on fire. 20 drones and 3 missiles claimed to have hit targets.
description: Fourteenth wave; IRGC Navy large-scale attack on US air base in Bahrain with drones and missiles.

outcome: Strikes on Al-Udeid Air Base Qatar and Israeli positions. IRGC claims 7 Israeli drones shot down (Hermes, Heron, MQ-9). Suspected cluster/fragmentation warhead detonation in Bnei Brak/Petah Tikva causing blast damage; 7 wounded (1 moderate, 6 light) per Haaretz.
description: Fifteenth wave; continued geographic expansion. Also targeted 10 key points at Sheikh Isa Air Base Bahrain. Air raid sirens in central Israel. IRGC claims to have shot down 7 Israeli drones.

outcome: IRGC claims strikes on HaKirya (IDF general staff and Ministry of War), strategic infrastructure in Bnei Brak, military targets in Beit Hakfa
description: Sixteenth wave; critical shift - IRGC Ground Forces entered the battlefield with three simultaneous operations and 230 attack drones. Multi-domain offensive. Aerospace Division also struck 'heart and northern parts of occupied territories.'
Seventeenth wave; codename 'Sacred: O Messenger of Allah.' 40+ ballistic missiles fired by IRGC Aerospace Force. Religious-nationalist messaging increasingly prominent.

codeName: Ya Hassan ibn Ali (peace be upon him)
outcome: IRGC claims strikes on Israeli Defense Ministry Tel Aviv, Ben Gurion Airport, 7+ US/Israeli radar systems destroyed. One missile struck open area in central Israel. Amazon facility Bahrain allegedly suffered extensive damage.
description: Nineteenth wave; codename 'Ya Hassan ibn Ali.' Combined missile and drone operation using Khorramshahr-4 ballistic missiles with 1-ton warheads. IRGC claims bypassed THAAD and struck Israeli Defense Ministry and Ben Gurion Airport. Also targeted USS Abraham Lincoln and Amazon data center in Bahrain. IDF reports most missiles intercepted; no casualties.

outcome: IRGC claims cluster warhead submunitions dispersed across target areas. No specific damage reports confirmed by Israeli sources.
description: Twenty-first wave of Operation True Promise 4. Codename 'Ya Mu'izz al-Mu'minin.' IRGC Aerospace Force launched combined suicide drone swarms and Kheibar Shekan ballistic missiles with cluster warheads at Tel Aviv early Friday morning on Day 7 of the conflict. IRGC stated the tactic was designed to overwhelm Israel's multi-layered air defences. Iran vowed 'more intense' operations in coming days. Cumulative munitions prior to this wave reportedly exceeded 2,000 drones and 600 missiles.

codeName: Ya Hossein ibn Ali (peace be upon him)
outcome: IRGC claims strikes on Tel Aviv, Ben Gurion Airport, military centers in Haifa. Claims Al Udeid radar systems, air traffic control, satellite stations, and fuel depots obliterated. Claims Al Dhafra early warning radar and critical infrastructure destroyed by precision strikes and drone swarms. No confirmed Israeli casualties.
description: Twenty-second wave of Operation True Promise 4. Codename 'Ya Hossein ibn Ali.' Significant escalation in weapon sophistication: first wave to combine Khorramshahr-4 (~1,500 kg warhead, Mach 16), Kheibar Shekan, and Fattah hypersonic missiles simultaneously. Targeted Tel Aviv, Ben Gurion Airport, Haifa military centers, plus Al Udeid and Al Dhafra air bases in the Gulf. IRGC framed as retaliation for Minab school strike. Iranian state media stated most missiles used in the war to date were from 2012-2014 production, and new generation weapons had only been deployed in rare cases until this wave.

Twenty-third wave of Operation True Promise 4. Announced late evening March 6 (Day 7). IRGC stated this phase would involve 'some of the world's most advanced missiles.' Targets reported across Israel and Gulf states including Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Saudi Arabia, and UAE. Israeli military confirmed intercepting missiles. Details remain sparse as the wave was announced only hours ago; this is a preliminary entry pending further OSINT confirmation.

outcome: Minor structural damage in Tel Aviv and Givatayim. Three missile impacts confirmed in Tel Aviv metro.
description: Twenty-fourth wave of Operation True Promise 4. Day 8 (March 7), dawn. Codename 'Ya Mahdi'. Kheibar Shekan, Emad, Ghadr ballistic missiles with cluster warheads targeting Tel Aviv. At least 3 impacts confirmed. IRGC released launch footage.

targets.name: Joint US-Israeli military centers and logistical support. Al

description: Twenty-fifth wave of Operation True Promise 4. Day 8 (March 7). Codename 'Al-Muqaddis / Ali ibn Abi Talib'. Fattah hypersonic and Emad missiles with Shahed-238 suicide drone swarms. Targeted joint US-Israeli military centers, Al-Dhafra and Al-Minhad Air Bases (UAE).

outcome: Damage to radar installations at Sdot Micha. Sirens in Kiryat Shmona and Upper Galilee.
description: Twenty-sixth wave of Operation True Promise 4. Day 8 (March 7). Combined drone-missile operation under codename 'Ya Heydar Karrar'. New-generation Emad, Ghadr, and multi-warhead Kheibar missiles with cluster warheads struck targets across northern and southern Israel including Jerusalem (cluster missile intercepted over city per Anadolu Agency and Israel National News). Sdot Micha strategic military facility targeted. Concurrent Iran army drone strikes against US bases at Al-Minhad (UAE) and Camp Udairi (Kuwait). IRGC claimed destruction of enemy radar systems in previous waves made striking targets easier.

outcome: Iranian state media claimed drone swarm hit Haifa refinery causing large fires. Unconfirmed.
description: Twenty-seventh wave of Operation True Promise 4. Day 8 (March 7), evening. Codename 'Ya Fatimah al-Zahra'. Khorramshahr-4 heavy ballistic and Fattah-2 hypersonic missiles with cluster warheads plus suicide drones. Targeted Haifa oil refinery and US positions at Camp Udairi/Buehring (Kuwait). Iranian media claimed fires at Haifa refinery.

outcome: Iranian media claimed direct ballistic missile impact in central Israel; large explosions reported in Tel Aviv. Unconfirmed independently.
description: Twenty-eighth wave of Operation True Promise 4. Day 9 (March 8). Featured Qadr, Emad (700kg-1 ton warheads), and Kheibar Shekan missiles (1,450 km range, terminal maneuverability, high strike accuracy). Targeted Tel Aviv, Be'er Sheva, and Al-Azraq Air Base (Jordan). Iranian media claimed THAAD radar systems destroyed in preceding 24h period.

Twenty-ninth wave of Operation True Promise 4. Day 9 (March 8), afternoon. Codename 'Ya Ali Ibn Abi Talib'. IRGC Aerospace Force launched new generation of missiles hitting targets in Tel Aviv, the Naqab (Negev), and US airbase in region. Details still emerging.

outcome: Iranian TV claimed "complete success"; specific damage details sparse.
description: Thirtieth wave of Operation True Promise 4. Day 10 (March 9), morning. First IRGC action since Mojtaba Khamenei became Supreme Leader on March 8. Featured Khorramshahr, Fattah hypersonic, and Kheibar Shekan ballistic missiles plus strategic drones. Sirens sounded in Netanya and Western Galilee. Iranian TV claimed complete success.

attacker: Iran IRGC Aerospace Force + Iran IRGC Navy

targets.name: Five strategic US bases (incl. US Navy 5th Fleet HQ); Israel

outcome: Cluster munition warhead struck at least 6 sites across central Israel — Yehud, Or Yehuda, Holon, Bat Yam, Rishon LeZion. Construction site hit in Yehud (1 killed, 1 critically wounded). Man seriously wounded in Or Yehuda. Woman moderately injured in Rishon LeZion from submunition partial detonation.
description: Thirty-first wave of Operation True Promise 4. Day 10 (March 9), afternoon. Codename "Labbaik Ya Khamenei" — dedicated to new Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei. Joint IRGC Aerospace Force and IRGC Navy operation. Featured super-heavy missiles (Qadr, Khorramshahr, Kheibar Shekan) plus naval loitering drones and cruise missiles. Targeted five strategic US bases including 5th Fleet HQ, Israeli military sites in Tel Aviv and Haifa, and US Al-Adiri helicopter base. Cluster munition strike in Bat Yam dispersed 24 submunitions across 6 locations. 2 killed in central Israel. Bahrain: 32 injured including children in strike on Sitra island.

targets.name: Sites in northern and central Israel

description: Thirty-second wave of Operation True Promise 4. Day 10 (March 9), evening. Codename "At Your Service, Khamenei" (also rendered as "The noose will tighten"). IRGC Aerospace Force launched Qadr and Khorramshahr ballistic missiles at sites in northern and central Israel. IRGC stated "heavy fire will continue to rain down" and warned of relentless pressure.

targets.name: Ramle (kindergarten and infrastructure hit); Mateh Yehuda Re

outcome: Kindergarten/daycare facility in Ramle struck and damaged. Infrastructure damage in Ramle. No warning sirens sounded.
description: Thirty-fourth wave of Operation True Promise 4. Day 10 (March 9), evening. Hezbollah long-range missile barrage targeting central Israel. 16 lightly wounded in Ramle including from kindergarten hit. Hezbollah claimed targets were IDF Home Front Command HQ (Rehavam Base) in Ramle and satellite communications station in Haela Valley near Beit Shemesh.

outcome: 10+ Khaibar Shekan missiles reportedly struck Tel Aviv, penetrating Iron Dome. Sdot Micha satellite communications center south of Tel Aviv reportedly destroyed by IRGC drones.
description: Thirty-third wave of Operation True Promise 4. Day 10 (March 9), late evening. Codename "At Your Service, Khamenei." Heaviest wave of the day. Large numbers of solid-fuel Khaibar Shekan missiles with one-ton warheads launched at Tel Aviv — 10+ impacts reported. IRGC Aerospace Force drones reportedly destroyed Sdot Micha satellite communications center south of Tel Aviv. US Navy 5th Fleet base also targeted with precision-guided missiles. IRGC Ruhollah Corps intercepted a cruise missile over central Iran and destroyed an Orbiter-4 drone over Isfahan.

outcome: No damage reported. All projectiles intercepted.
description: Thirty-sixth wave of Operation True Promise 4. Day 11 (March 10). IRGC launched 17 ballistic missiles and 6 drones at Qatar. Qatar Armed Forces successfully intercepted all incoming projectiles with no casualties or damage reported. Part of ongoing Iranian targeting of Gulf States hosting US military assets. Qatari Ministry of Defence released video of interceptions.

codeName: First Wave Under the New Ayatollah
outcome: Construction site in Yehud struck. Submunitions impacted across six sites in Yehud, Or Yehuda, Holon, Bat Yam, and Rishon Letzion.
description: Thirty-fifth wave of Operation True Promise 4. Day 11 (March 10), overnight. IRGC launched ballistic missile with cluster warhead at central Israel. Submunitions scattered across at least six sites in Yehud, Or Yehuda, Holon, Bat Yam, and Rishon Letzion. One man killed at construction site in Yehud, two men seriously wounded at same site. Woman moderately wounded by debris in Rishon Letzion. Iranian state broadcaster IRIB hailed this as the 'first wave of missiles under Mojtaba Khamenei towards occupied territories.'

description: Forty-first wave of Operation True Promise 4. Day 12 (March 11), afternoon. After a nine-hour pause, IRGC launched a fresh ballistic missile salvo from Iran targeting central and northern Israel at approximately 1:45 PM local time. Al Jazeera reported heavy, multi-warhead projectiles with interceptions observed over Israel. At least one missile reportedly reached the Tel Aviv area. Sirens sounded in central and northern Israel.
